function.name: find_hotel_videos
function.description: Find YouTube videos of a specific hotel (room tours, walkthroughs, reviews, or news). Use ONLY when the guest explicitly asks to see, watch, or be shown video content — never as a substitute for textual answers the knowledge base can give. Pick the intent that best matches the request.

hotel_name.description: The hotel's name as the guest said it (or the property in scope for this call).

intent.description: What kind of video the guest is asking for: 'tour' = general walkthrough; 'rooms' = room-tour focus; 'review' = traveler/professional review; 'news' = recent / dated content. Default to 'tour' if unclear.

region.description: Optional city or region to disambiguate a common hotel name (e.g. 'Istanbul'). Omit if the hotel name is already unique.

language.description: Optional ISO-639-1 code (e.g. 'en', 'tr', 'es') to bias results to videos with that audio/title language.

max_results.description: Number of videos to return, 1..10. Default 5. Pick a smaller number when the guest only wants a quick look.
